title: Premise Health patient data taken by an employee, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Premise Health, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: About 2.76 million people across the US, per the company's state filing, with Social Security numbers and health details for many. Care itself was not disrupted.
who_is_affected: People whose data Premise Health held, mostly members of employer-sponsored health centers. Those affected are getting letters from Nov 6, 2026.

known.text: Premise Health says an employee misappropriated company data starting on or about March 26, 2026.
The company says it was not a hacking or ransomware event.
It was found on Sept 18, 2026; the employee was fired and the case reported to law enforcement.
About 2.76 million people are affected, per the company's filing listed by Oregon.
The data may include names, birth dates, Social Security numbers, insurance and treatment information.

not_known.text: Why the employee took the data, or where it went.
Whether any of it has been misused.
Why Oregon's listing ends the breach dates on March 30.
Whether law enforcement has taken any action.
